summary: The Hermite Lp packaging exposes the right family and representatives, but the normalization API is not stated in the object-level forms downstream users need. Replace the expanded/norm-square public facts with characteristic `hermiteFunction` and `inner` normal forms, keeping proof-only expansions private.
